confidence_notes: FX is the RBA observation for 2026-11-18, found via search of the RBA overview page, so the date is later than the July 2026 reference window. Food and drink anchors come from one search of aggregated cost-of-living sources (Numbeo-style data and travel guides). Those sources are sparse and disagree with each other. Cocktail is based on guide prices of 150-250 THB. Wine by the glass is estimated from bottle prices of about 620 THB and a typical restaurant markup, not from a direct quote. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from general knowledge, with no listings inspected. Prices swing widely between high and low season, and July is low season, so they could be lower than usual.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other Thai island destinations such as Koh Lipe, Koh Phangan and Krabi beach areas, with island pricing a little above mainland Thailand.
